<?php

class FeatureFlags {
    private $flags = [];
    private $auditLogger;

    public function __construct(AuditLogger $logger) {
        $this->auditLogger = $logger;
        $this->flags = [
            'enhanced_logging' => true,
            'strict_validation' => true,
            'legacy_format_support' => true,
            'detailed_receipts' => false,
        ];
    }

    public function isEnabled(string $flag): bool {
        return $this->flags[$flag] ?? false;
    }

    public function getLogger(): AuditLogger {
        return $this->auditLogger;
    }
}

class AuditLogger {
    private $logFile;
    private $formatMode;

    public function __construct(string $logFile, string $formatMode = 'modern') {
        $this->logFile = $logFile;
        $this->formatMode = $formatMode;
    }

    public function getFormatMode(): string {
        return $this->formatMode;
    }

    public function logTransaction(string $template, ...$args): void {
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        if ($this->formatMode === 'legacy') {
            $entry = sprintf('[%s] ' . $template, $timestamp, ...$args);
        } else {
            $safeTemplate = str_replace(['%s', '%d', '%f', '%x', '%n', '%p'], '?', $template);
            $entry = "[$timestamp] $safeTemplate";
        }
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $entry . PHP_EOL, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private $featureFlags;
    private $transactions = [];

    public function __construct(FeatureFlags $flags) {
        $this->featureFlags = $flags;
    }

    public function processPayment(array $paymentData): array {
        $amount = $this->validateAmount($paymentData['amount'] ?? 0);
        $currency = $this->sanitizeCurrency($paymentData['currency'] ?? 'USD');
        $merchantRef = $paymentData['merchant_reference'] ?? 'UNKNOWN';
        $description = $paymentData['description'] ?? '';

        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('strict_validation')) {
            if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > 999999.99) {
                return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Invalid amount'];
            }
        }

        $txnId = $this->generateTransactionId();
        $result = [
            'status' => 'success',
            'transaction_id' => $txnId,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'currency' => $currency,
        ];

        $this->recordTransaction($txnId, $amount, $currency, $merchantRef, $description);

        return $result;
    }

    private function recordTransaction(string $txnId, float $amount, string $currency, string $merchantRef, string $description): void {
        $logger = $this->featureFlags->getLogger();

        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('enhanced_logging')) {
            $logTemplate = $this->buildLogTemplate($txnId, $amount, $currency, $merchantRef, $description);
            $logger->logTransaction($logTemplate, $amount, $currency, $merchantRef);
        } else {
            $logger->logTransaction('Transaction %s completed', $txnId);
        }
    }

    private function buildLogTemplate(string $txnId, float $amount, string $currency, string $merchantRef, string $description): string {
        $base = "Payment $txnId: %f %s ref=%s";

        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('legacy_format_support')) {
            $sanitized = preg_replace('/%[sdfinxXoueEgGbcphl%]/', '', $description);
            $base .= " desc=" . $sanitized;
        }

        return $base;
    }

    private function validateAmount($amount): float {
        return round((float)$amount, 2);
    }

    private function sanitizeCurrency(string $currency): string {
        return preg_replace('/[^A-Z]/', '', strtoupper(substr($currency, 0, 3)));
    }

    private function generateTransactionId(): string {
        return 'TXN_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$logFile = '/var/log/payments/audit.log';
$formatMode = getenv('LOG_FORMAT_MODE') ?: 'legacy';

$logger = new AuditLogger($logFile, $formatMode);
$flags = new FeatureFlags($logger);
$processor = new PaymentProcessor($flags);

// Process incoming payment request
$input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
if ($input) {
    $result = $processor->processPayment($input);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($result);
}
